question: Which of the following committees was constituted in 2012 to review the Poverty Measurement Methodology and submitted its report in June 2014?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rangarajan Committee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Rangarajan Committee__

 
 
• The government formed the Rangarajan Committee to review the standards and methods of the Tendulkar Committee.
 
• The Rangarajan Committee has rejected the Tendulkar Committee's assessment, saying that three out of every ten people in the country are poor.
 
• However, the number of poor has decreased in two years.
 
• The Rangarajan committee has submitted the report to Planning Minister Rao Inderjit Singh.
 
• No action was taken by the Central Government on the Rangarajan Committee report, due to which the people living in poverty in the country are calculated on the basis of the poverty line set by the Tendulkar Committee.
 
• According to the Tendulkar Committee, 21.9% of the total population of India lives below the poverty line.
